description: Defines the AudioStream class for Android's AAudio API, including its interface, state management, threading, and callback handling.

classes.name: AudioStream
classes.description: Represents an audio stream in the Android AAudio API, managing state, configuration, threading, and callbacks.

classes.name: MyPlayerBase
classes.description: Inner class managing system control of the stream volume and registration with AudioManager.

methods.name: checkPauseStateTransition
methods.description: Checks if pausing is allowed based on current state.

methods.name: isFlushSupported
methods.description: Indicates if flush operation is supported (only for output streams).

methods.name: isPauseSupported
methods.description: Indicates if pause operation is supported (only for output streams).

methods.name: requestStart_l
methods.description: Requests to start the stream (must be implemented by subclasses).

methods.name: requestPause_l
methods.description: Requests to pause the stream (optional implementation).

methods.name: requestFlush_l
methods.description: Requests to flush the stream (optional implementation).

methods.name: requestStop_l
methods.description: Requests to stop the stream (must be implemented by subclasses).

methods.name: getTimestamp
methods.description: Retrieves timestamp info for the stream.

methods.name: updateStateMachine
methods.description: Updates the internal state machine of the stream.

methods.name: processCommands
methods.description: Processes pending commands for the stream.

methods.name: waitForStateChange
methods.description: Waits for the stream state to change from currentState.

methods.name: open
methods.description: Opens the stream with parameters from the builder.

methods.name: logOpenActual
methods.description: Logs actual open parameters for metrics.

methods.name: close_l
methods.description: Closes the stream and frees resources.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns a unique identifier for the stream.

methods.name: setBufferSize
methods.description: Sets the buffer size for the stream.

methods.name: createThread
methods.description: Creates a background thread for the stream.

methods.name: registerThread
methods.description: Registers the thread with the system.

methods.name: getStateExternal
methods.description: Returns current stream state for external use.

methods.name: isSharingModeMatchRequired
methods.description: Checks if sharing mode match is required.

methods.name: isPrivacySensitive
methods.description: Checks if stream is privacy sensitive.

methods.name: getRequireMonoBlend
methods.description: Checks if mono blend is required.

methods.name: getDataCallbackUserData
methods.description: Returns user data for data callback.

methods.name: getErrorCallbackUserData
methods.description: Returns user data for error callback.

methods.name: setChannelMask
methods.description: Sets channel mask and updates samples per frame.

methods.name: isDataCallbackSet
methods.description: Checks if data callback is set.

methods.name: isDataCallbackActive
methods.description: Checks if data callback is active and stream is active.

methods.name: collidesWithCallback
methods.description: Checks if called from callback thread.

methods.name: doSetVolume
methods.description: Sets volume, to be implemented by subclasses.

methods.name: systemStart
methods.description: Starts the stream at system level.

methods.name: systemPause
methods.description: Pauses the stream at system level.

methods.name: systemStopFromApp
methods.description: Stops the stream as requested by app.

methods.name: safeReleaseClose
methods.description: Releases and closes the stream safely.

methods.name: safeReleaseCloseInternal
methods.description: Internal method to release and close.
